note: The Lean majorant carries the factor `weight c beta = beta * share * bulk c <= beta`, a mild strengthening of M's majorant with beta replaced by |beta - beta_0|. The addresses and tests do not depend on beta because `payload` fixes them.

lemma differenceE (ht : b.threshold ≤ threshold G b.order b.power) (i : Sheet n) :
    variesRegular (G:=G) b (eInfo i) (written c i x) (written c i y) (‖weight c x - weight c y‖*item G b) := by
  have hp := item_pos G b
  refine ⟨by positivity,?_⟩
  intro U hU l hl hD
  cases i with
  | inr i => simp [written,hp.le, mul_nonneg]
  | inl i =>
    change ‖leftDerivs (weight c x • i.accrual) l U - leftDerivs (weight c y • i.accrual) l U‖ ≤ _
    rw [left_mult,left_mult,← sub_mul,norm_mul]; gcongr
    exact (accrual_fit i ht).2 U hU l hl hD

proof_context.conclusion: The regular activities at couplings `x` and `y` differ by a regular majorant `||weight c x - weight c y|| * item G b`, with the same address and support.

theorem charge_range (h : c.direct ≤ 1) (U : Config G n) (D : Support n) :
    charge c b D U ∈ Set.Icc 0 (share * ((Fintype.card (Key n) : ℝ)*2)) := by
  unfold charge
  have he := fun i : Key n => due_range c b h (i.frame U) i.root
  refine ⟨mul_nonneg share_pos.le (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => by split <;> first | exact (he i).1 | exact le_rfl),?_⟩
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ share_pos.le
  rw [show (Fintype.card (Key n) : ℝ)*2 = ∑ _i : Key n,(2:ℝ) by simp]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => by split <;> first | exact (he i).2 | norm_num

proof_context.conclusion: `charge c b D U` lies in `[0, share * (card Key * 2)]`, so d_I is nonnegative and bounded at fixed volume.
